decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service is close to the firm's core geospatial IT integration know-how, and its 2024 promotion to a page of its own shows growing commitment that in-house R&D can build on.

The open GIS application development framework sits close to the firm's established open, extensible components and its standards work, so the firm can interpret results and refine it, even though website visibility stayed at a mention.

The identity and access service for GIS applications was actively promoted and gained its own page in 2024, and it builds directly on related knowledge the firm already holds, so it fits the firm's capacity to assimilate and improve.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's decades of consulting and training experience, has its own page, and was only launched in 2024, so management will keep it to learn from early results.
